historyDescription: The app keeps track of all the entries you have found and explored in the book. If you like, you can delete your progress and start over – or save it to your account below.
historyDescriptionLocal: The app keeps track of all the entries you have found and explored in the book. If you like, you can delete your progress and start over.
historyConfirm: Delete all saved progress for this book on this device?
historyDone: All saved progress on this device was deleted.
feedbackDescription: Short sounds and vibrations when you scroll through the pages, tap a button or find a page.
installButton: Install as app on this device
installDone: You're using the app from your home screen.
installDescription: The app then opens full screen from its own icon and starts faster.
installIos: In Safari, tap Share (the square with the arrow), then "Add to Home Screen". The app then opens full screen from its own icon.
installManual: Open your browser's menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" or "Install app", if your browser offers it.
downloadDescription: Loads all content of the book ({{size}}) onto this device in advance, so nothing has to load while you use the app – faster, and it also works without internet. Best on Wi-Fi.
downloadDone: All content is on this device ({{size}}) – nothing has to load while you use the app.
downloadFailed: Some files could not be downloaded ({{size}} in total). Check your connection and try again.
historyDescriptionAccount: The app keeps track of all the entries you have found and explored in the book – on this device and in your account. Resetting deletes your progress in both places, so you can start over.
historyConfirmAccount: Delete all saved progress for this book – on this device and in your account?
installAdded: The app is installed – open it from your home screen or app list.
